args: Temperatures are stored in tenths of a degree Celsius, as integers.
Readings older than 90 days are moved to cold storage.
Alerts are sent through PagerDuty from src/alerts.rs.
Station ids are the sensor's MAC address in lowercase.
The API returns timestamps as Unix milliseconds.
